mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, user_id, template_id, status, current_stage, fail_stage, fail_reason, result_url, created_at, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{status}, #{currentStage}, #{failStage}, #{failReason}, #{resultUrl}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, template_id, status, current_stage, fail_stage, fail_reason, result_url, created_at, started_at, finished_at FROM task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.template_id, tpl.title AS template_title, tpl.cover_url AS template_cover_url, t.status, t.current_stage, t.fail_stage, t.fail_reason, t.result_url, t.created_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at FROM task t JOIN template tpl ON tpl.id = t.template_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT id, user_id, template_id, status, current_stage, fail_stage, fail_reason, result_url, created_at, started_at, finished_at FROM task WHERE status IN ('WAITING', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'WAITING', current_stage = NULL, fail_stage = NULL, fail_reason = NULL, result_url = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCESS', result_url = #{resultUrl}, fail_stage = NULL, fail_reason = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', fail_stage = #{failStage}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, result_url = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
